## Work unit and behavior

Stable unit ID(s):

Describe the concrete problem, implemented result, and any remaining scope. Link the canonical unit in `registry/prs.json`; add the actual GitHub PR number after creation.

## Validation and source/security review

List checks actually executed, results, and the commit/source they assess. Include relevant negative, integration, browser, permission, recovery, or adversarial cases. Identify any unexecuted live-provider checks precisely. Fix actual failures before merging; no independent human review or certification is required.

## Rollback and operations

Describe rollback/feature disable, migrations, data compatibility, and deployment/acceptance evidence when applicable. Keep merge status separate from operational acceptance. Do not put credentials or private data here.
